abstract.para: Keep the local &rmt; database up to date with product and repository information from &scc;.

topic.para: The local &rmt; database needs to be updated periodically with the information downloaded from &scc;. This includes information about available products and repositories.
The synchronization is activated by the &systemd; timer rmt-server-sync.timer. To view its status, for example, the next running time, use systemctl status.

Jun 22 04:22:34 d31 systemd[1]: Started RMT Sync timer.
topic.para: If the timer is not enabled or started, start it manually.
To update the &rmt; database manually, use the rmt-cli sync command. For details, see the rmt-cli command reference.
